description: Upload a file to the family's Latest uploads (or straight into a folder with folderId). Files has **Latest uploads** (unfiled files: they land there, expire after a set number of days unless moved into a folder, and have a separate cap) and **folders** (kept files count toward the family's storage limit). Storage, Latest-uploads and per-file size caps apply; list_folders reports current usage. Private files and folders are never visible to assistants. For a file of 10 MB or less, pass dataBase64 and it uploads immediately. For a larger file, pass sizeBytes instead (omit dataBase64): the result is a presigned upload target and instructions for completing the upload yourself. To file it straight away, pass folderPath (e.g. "Alva/Vaccination") instead of folderId, and details to record its dates, people and facts. Filing convention: a document about one person goes under that person first ("Alva/Vaccination"); anything else topic first ("Sports/Football/Rules"). At most 3 levels; existing folders are reused by name, missing ones are created.

contentType.description: MIME type — must match the filename's extension

dataBase64.description: Base64-encoded file bytes, 10 MB decoded or less

details.description: Dates, people and facts to record on the file

documentDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD: when the document was issued, taken or given

dueAt.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the next deadline, renewal or dose

facts.description: Up to 12 facts a parent would look up later, e.g. { "label": "Vaccine", "value": "TBE" }. Replaces the current list.

memberIds.description: Family member ids the document concerns (from get_members)

folderId.description: Destination folder; omit to land in Latest uploads

folderPath.description: Folder path like "Alva/Vaccination"; missing folders are created. Use instead of folderId, never both.

sizeBytes.description: Required instead of dataBase64 for a file over the base64 limit

name: upload_file
title: Upload file
